ops.title: Declarative flag-arity argv util + cc-context adoption
ops.description: The three-surface inventory (2026-07-18 rm-guard wave) found 26 hand-rolled command-walk sites across captain-hook, cc-context, and sibling consumers, most re-implementing "which args are targets vs flags" with ad-hoc `startswith("-")` filters (e.g. `rm_targets` in packs/general/deletions.py, `resolve_cd`'s arg matching, fixes/_lib.py's git flag handling with `GIT_VALUE_FLAGS`). Design a declarative per-command flag-arity spec (which flags consume a value, where `--` ends options) as a captain_hook util or cc-transcript layer, then adopt it across the inventoried sites. Family-level abstraction per the design-globally rule — not per-repo point fixes.
